_readme: Manually researched signals for the NorthStar Anesthesia ABM Signal Tracker, gathered via real web research (batch-by-batch, 5 companies at a time) while the permanent Sheets-based signal pipeline is being wired up. Each entry becomes one row in the 'alerts_sent' table via seed_northstar_signals.py. signal_type must be one of the canonical strings tracker/signal_score.py and tracker/dashboard_builder.py expect: 'Funding Round', 'Acquisition / M&A', 'IPO Signal', 'C-Suite Join', 'C-Suite Exit', 'News Mention', 'Product Launch', 'Partnership', 'Creative Hiring' (this last one is displayed to NorthStar as 'Anesthesiologists' via the hiring_opts override in build_northstar_dashboard.py -- the stored key stays 'Creative Hiring' so the shared scoring engine needs only one constant). confidence (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, from the research pass) is written straight into the 'severity' column -- it is the closest available proxy for alert importance and is what actually drives the dashboard's H/M/L counts.
companies_covered: Lecanto Surgery Center (researched, genuinely no public signal)

signals.signal_detail: Actively and broadly recruiting anesthesiologists and CRNAs across Arizona and Colorado, with sign-on bonuses up to $100K.
Banner Gateway Medical Center (Gilbert, AZ) offering CRNAs a $50K sign-on bonus and $260K+ annual comp for an employed practice opportunity.
Banner University Medicine Tucson (w/ U. of Arizona) actively interviewing anesthesiologists at $530K+/yr, plus recruiting a CRNA Manager at $275K+.
Banner Health Community Hospital (Torrington, CO) recruiting CRNAs for an independent rural-hospital anesthesia practice at ~$375K.
Upgrading its entire surgical robot fleet to 49 Intuitive da Vinci 5 systems across AZ/CO/WY -- one of the largest such investments by any US health system.
Expanded its AI-powered OR scheduling/automation platform (with Qventus) system-wide after a pilot added 2.1 cases per OR per month.
Opened Banner Cardiovascular Center - Arcadia, a new outpatient heart-care surgery center in Phoenix.
Broke ground on a new 384,000 sq-ft Banner Scottsdale Medical Center (cardiovascular, orthopedics, neuroscience), opening 2026.
Banner Estrella Medical Center completed a $35M expansion adding hospital beds, surgical suites and obstetric suites.
Banner Health / Atlas Healthcare Partners ambulatory surgery center JV continues expanding across Phoenix and Tucson, targeting 50+ ASCs.
Amy Perry became President and CEO effective June 30, 2024, succeeding longtime CEO Peter Fine.
Longtime CEO Peter Fine retired after 24 years effective June 30, 2024, remaining as CEO Emeritus/advisor through 2025.
Named Ryan Koos as new SVP and Chief Supply Chain Officer, effective June 16, 2025.
Dr. Benjamin Schwartz joined in 2025 as President of Academic Delivery, leading its academic medicine division.
Banner - University Medical Center Phoenix and Tucson named among U.S. News 2025-26 Best Regional Hospitals in Arizona.
CEO Amy Perry named to Modern Healthcare's 100 Most Influential People in Healthcare for the second consecutive year.
Deborah Lief, RN, named COO in Oct 2016; Lise McConnell named CFO in 2016.
Texas Health Plano and Texas Back Institute began offering the SpineAssist surgical robot (one of only three in the US at the time).
Listed as an affiliated location/provider within Southwestern Health Resources, the UT Southwestern / Texas Health Resources clinically integrated network.
Dr. Richard D. Guyer received D Magazine's 'Best Doctors' recognition for 2025 and 2026.
Orlando Health actively and repeatedly recruiting BE/BC anesthesiologists dedicated exclusively to Jewett Orthopedic Institute, live on multiple physician job boards.
Separate posting seeks a full team of anesthesiologists for Jewett, M-F schedule with no call/nights/weekends and a starting bonus -- sustained recruitment need, not one vacancy.

Orlando Health completed a $439M acquisition of Steward Health Care's 3 East Central Florida hospitals and affiliated physician practices, folding the orthopedic physicians into Jewett Orthopedic Institute.
Statewide expansion integrating 26 new ortho/sports-med physicians, bringing the Institute to 24 clinics, 94 physicians and 118 APPs statewide.
Plans a new 27,000 sq-ft, two-story Winter Park campus (ortho care, rehab, imaging, walk-in clinic), approved by the Winter Park Planning & Zoning Board.
Received a 2025 Human Experience Guardian of Excellence Award from Press Ganey for patient experience.
The Innovation Center at Jewett Orthopedic Institute made a strategic investment in Orthopedic Driven Imaging (ODI) to advance a patient-specific surgery imaging ecosystem.
Dr. Michael V. Jablonski now serves as SVP of Orlando Health and President of both Jewett Orthopedic Institute and Orlando Health Neuroscience Institute (confirmed in role as of July 2025).
Terry Forde, former President/CEO of Adventist HealthCare, became President and CEO, officially starting August 2024.
Kristen Pulio joined as Executive VP and CFO after leaving Adventist HealthCare, around September 2024.
Matt Gerrell, President and CEO of Health First Health Plans, departed abruptly after 19 years; COO Jamie Forrest named interim president.

Health First and Parrish Healthcare signed agreements integrating health-plan networks and transferring the Health First Cancer Institute building in Titusville to Parrish, resolving prior legal disputes.
Broke ground on a new 268,000 sq-ft Cape Canaveral Hospital, 120 beds, six ORs, plus Brevard County's first freestanding ER.
Board authorized a master plan to expand Viera Hospital to 214 beds, adding two new ORs and a cardiac catheterization lab.
Announced a $230M, five-floor patient tower expansion of Palm Bay Hospital, construction slated for summer 2026.
Expanded emergency care capacity and fast-tracked new ER access across Brevard County following the closure of Orlando Health Rockledge Hospital in April 2025.

Multiple 2024 accolades: Newsweek World's Best Hospitals (Cape Canaveral, 4th year running), U.S. News #1 Brevard/#17 Florida (Holmes Regional), CMS 5-Star (Viera Hospital), Leapfrog 'A' grade (Cape Canaveral).
Open Director of Perioperative Services role for Holmes Regional Medical Center (515-bed, 16-OR facility) in Melbourne, FL, listed via Whitman Partners.
Colorectal surgeon Dr. Bidhan Das joined as a new partner.
Surgeon Dr. Buckminster J. Farrow awarded Memorial Hermann's 2025 Charlotte Alexander Exemplary Physician Award for medical mission work.
Paid $65,000 to HHS OCR to settle a HIPAA Right of Access violation for failing to provide a patient timely access to their records.
Optum (UnitedHealth Group) completed its acquisition of Kelsey-Seybold Clinic Partners from TPG for approximately $2 billion.
TPG Capital made a non-controlling strategic equity investment in Kelsey-Seybold Management Services (the MSO), later superseded by the 2022 Optum acquisition.
Azam Kundi, M.D. (previously Medical Director for M&A and Vice Chairman of the Board) was elevated to Chairman and CEO of Kelsey-Seybold Clinic.
Broke ground on a new 34,000 sq-ft clinic in Missouri City (Fort Bend Town Center), its seventh Fort Bend County location, opening summer 2026.
New five-story, 135,000 sq-ft Lake Houston Campus (up to 51 providers) opened and began accepting patients.
Opened a new 36,000 sq-ft clinic in Houston's Upper Kirby District.
Added a da Vinci Xi Surgical System at its Springwoods Village Campus ASC for general, gynecologic, and urologic minimally-invasive procedures.
Memorial Villages Campus Surgery Center uses Mako SmartRobotics for robotic-guided partial knee replacement procedures.
Own careers site has an open, actively-recruiting CRNA - Anesthesiology role at Springwoods Village (salary $191,500-$261,500).
Separately recruiting a Physician - Anesthesiologist (MD/CRNA Anesthesia Care Team lead model, no call/weekends/holidays) for its Houston ambulatory surgery practice.
Multiple additional CRNA/anesthesiologist listings (Main Campus and Springwoods Village) cross-posted on UnitedHealth Group's careers portal, indicating multi-site ongoing anesthesia hiring need.
Expanding its value-based Medicare Advantage coordinated-care model with plans including Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, and WellCare across Greater Houston.
Axion Spine & Neurosurgery's physicians operate as clinical partners within the Wellstar Health System network, with multiple Axion locations listed under Wellstar's physician directory.
Expanding its North Atlanta footprint, adding Sandy Springs and Riverdale locations alongside its original Alpharetta practice and surgery center.
Closed a $175 million credit expansion to fund continued growth through 2026.
Current PE sponsor is Oak Hill Capital, which recapitalized the company in November 2021, succeeding original backer Thurston Group.
Named Doug Drew (former Global President of Mars Veterinary Health) as new CEO, effective July 1, 2025.
Longtime CEO Richard Hall stepped down effective July 1, 2025, transitioning to Chairman of the Board.
Named by Becker's Healthcare to its 2025 'DSOs to Know' list.
Named 'Top Oral Surgery Practice Management Service' for 2025 by Healthcare Business Review.
Added Northern Virginia Oral, Maxillofacial & Implant Surgery (4 surgeons, 3 sites) as a new partner practice.
Secured three new partner practices in Maryland, New York, and Oregon, reaching a network spanning 31 states.

Envision Physician Services / Kendall Anesthesia Associates (exclusive anesthesia group at Baptist Hospital of Miami since 1960) is actively recruiting General Anesthesiologists, a Cardiac Anesthesiologist, CRNAs, and a Certified Anesthesiologist Assistant, with sign-on bonuses up to $100,000.
Own careers portal lists open Anesthesia Tech positions in Miami and at the new Boca Raton Regional tower, signaling anesthesia-department staffing growth tied to facility expansion.
Carlos Hernandez named CEO of Baptist Health Doctors Hospital and head of Baptist Health Orthopedics, effective May 1, 2026.
Nathaniel Ortiz named CEO of Baptist Health West Kendall Baptist Hospital, effective May 1, 2026.
Baptist Health and Lifepoint Health began construction on a joint-venture Rehabilitation Hospital in South Miami, opening August 2026, creating 200+ jobs.
Opened a new freestanding emergency room (Dr. Harry Richard Nateman Center) in Palmetto Bay, operating as a department of Baptist Health Doctors Hospital.
Center for Robotic Heart & Vascular Surgery added AI-powered 'digital twin' 3D heart-modeling software to plan cardiac surgeries in advance.
Broke ground on its first Broward County hospital, Baptist Health Sunrise Hospital (340,000 sq-ft).
Broke ground on a new Medical Center in Pembroke Pines (60,865 sq-ft, ER and outpatient services), opening early 2027.
Named the most-awarded healthcare system in South Florida for the 15th consecutive year, earning 63 high-performing honors in U.S. News & World Report's 2025-2026 Best Hospitals rankings.
Named to Fortune's 2025 list of America's Most Innovative Companies.
